_comment: Config for the in-page correction requests.
THE FORM IS TWO QUESTIONS. Everything a submitter needs to see is in one
editable box; everything the pipeline needs is in one opaque reference.
1. Corrected transcript  (paragraph, prefilled with '[Name]: text')
The speaker label lives INSIDE the text, so fixing a name and fixing
the words are the same action. Multiple lines = a SPLIT into separate
turns, which is the roll-call case. An optional '[seconds]' prefix on
a line corrects that turn's timing:
[647.707] [Clerk]: Councilor Bears?
[649.1] [Zac Bears]: Present.
2. Reference, do not edit  (short answer, prefilled '<video_id>@<t>')
WHY ONLY A REFERENCE: Google Forms has no hidden fields, so every context
field we send is a field the submitter has to look at and ignore. Rather
than prefill video id, title, speaker, original text and page url as five
distracting boxes, we send the two values that IDENTIFY the line and let
ingest_corrections.py read the originals back out of the transcript. The
originals were never needed in the form; they were only needed for the
diff, and the transcript is a better source for them than a round trip
through a text box the user can accidentally edit.
Field ids come from a 'Get pre-filled link' URL. To change the form,
repeat that and update the ids below.
Sheet access needs no auth: a link-shared responses sheet exports CSV at
/spreadsheets/d/<SHEET_ID>/export?format=csv
ANONYMIZATION IS OFF pending a policy decision and a process to fulfil
requests. anonymize_notice is kept so re-enabling is easy -- but the menu
is a public promise, so do not restore it before the process exists.
NOTHING here is secret; this file is public config.
anonymize_notice: Anonymization is offered to members of the public, not to elected officials, candidates for office, or city staff speaking in their official capacity. If you later run for or hold public office, your name will be restored across the archive so that candidates remain accountable for their public statements. We can remove your name from this site, but not from the city's own published video.
